== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Cloud City: Lower Corridor (V) (Playtest)]] (Playtest), as published: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3d2c89e5f02cee6c39d70bd023260b638f3c0dc1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/cloudcitylowercorridor.gif Holotable image repository, commit 3d2c89e] “Set 24 New Cards”, 26 December 2024. Uploaded unchanged (byte-for-byte copy of that commit's file; the PC stores it as PNG data under a .gif name, so it is uploaded here with a .png extension). Later replaced at the same address by the next version's image.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-0/06/V24-L-cloudcitylowercorridor-original.png Internet Archive item].
